patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct swing lows visible: left shoulder near 1790, head at 1725, right shoulder near 1780. Neckline resistance around 1820-1825. Current price 1832.86 trades above neckline.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after price broke above prior swing high following the low at 1725. Sequence of higher highs and higher lows established.
